title: Non-UTF-8 bytes outside the specifier are corrupted in edited files

expectedChecks.reason: byte 0xE9 in the comment became EF BF BD: a byte outside the specifier span changed (base file is not valid UTF-8)

notes: The confirmation repo has no staged output; the hunt repo (r6-latin1.sh) has it. No good/ tree: the executor contract declines any edit to a non-UTF-8 file (unsupported-encoding), and K2 rejects such edits by design.
